procedures.procedure: Ran the 20% pool-concentration test (the same test implemented in the project's StratificationQA.bas VBA macro) against an ILLUSTRATIVE, SYNTHETIC property-type mix for Benchmark 2024-V7 (CMBS) -- not the deal's actual collateral tape. The real loan-level collateral tape for a CMBS deal is a separate, large data file that is not included in the prospectus summary excerpt used elsewhere in this work paper and was not independently sourced for this exercise. This procedure demonstrates the concentration-test mechanics on realistic-shaped synthetic data; it is not a finding about this specific deal's actual property-type concentration and must not be read or cited as one.
exceptions: Multifamily bucket at 36.50% of pool exceeds the 20% concentration threshold.
Office bucket at 30.42% of pool exceeds the 20% concentration threshold.
Industrial bucket at 21.90% of pool exceeds the 20% concentration threshold.
